description: All-in-one workspace for notes, docs, project management, and databases.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 for public integrations/apps, personal access tokens (PATs), and internal connection tokens using Bearer authentication.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Notion account and immediately generate personal access tokens or configure internal/OAuth integrations via the Developer portal for free.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering pages, blocks, databases, comments, users, file uploads, search, and agent capabilities.
mcp_notes: Official Notion MCP server is published by Notion on GitHub (makenotion/notion-mcp-server).
rationale: Notion provides a fully documented public REST API, free self-serve credential creation via personal access tokens or OAuth, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready to use as an agent toolkit today.

evidence.note: Details OAuth2 flow, personal access tokens, and internal connection token authentication.
Explains how developers can set up personal access tokens and connections free via the Developer portal.
Outlines the Notion REST API endpoints, base URL, versioning, and object models.
Shows the official makenotion/notion-mcp-server repository published by Notion.
